emily (new-hire): hi folks! 2nd day and trying to wire up secrets for our `metrics-ingest` service. flow question: do i ask for a Vault path + KMS key in one ticket or separate?
noah (DevEx): welcome! :wave: single secrets-request ticket is fine. include service name, repo, envs, list of secrets (ex: DB_PASSWORD, S3_ROLE_ARN), and whether you need cross-account decrypt. we route to infra+security automatically.
onboarding-bot: Received SR-2026-632 for `metrics-ingest`. Next: DevEx review, infra KMS provisioning, security prod review. Track: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/SR-2026-632
emily (new-hire): thanks. any convention for naming the Vault path?
dmitri (infra): use kv v2: `kv/data/services/<team>/<service>`. so `kv/data/services/observability/metrics-ingest`. KMS key id pattern: `projects/redwood/kms/keys/<team>-<service>-key`. Put explicit env list in the ticket.
emily (new-hire): do new hires get broad read perms in dev by default?
noah (DevEx): dev read by default for team-scoped paths. prod access requires owner signoff + security review. Humans don't get raw KMS decrypt for prod; services get a service identity with kms:decrypt role.
emily (new-hire): want ephemeral creds for my feature branch CI. how do i get that set up?
rachel (eng-security): use ephemeral DB creds via the DB plugin or short-lived Vault tokens. example: `vault token create -policy=feature-metrics-123 -ttl=3h`. CI can request tokens with the service account role. avoid long-lived secrets in PRs.
emily (new-hire): if i need to rotate a password after a test failure, can i rotate myself?
dmitri (infra): for dev/stage yes if you have write in the path. run `vault kv put kv/data/services/observability/metrics-ingest DB_PASSWORD=<new>` and create a new version. For prod, open a change ticket and coordinate a maintenance window.
rachel (eng-security): incident rotation note: mark SR as incident if secret is compromised. Security + oncall will revoke tokens, rotate credentials, and if necessary rotate KMS key material. containment target: 4h.
emily (new-hire): i submitted the form. anything else before infra touches keys?
onboarding-bot: Checklist for SR-2026-632: [ ] secrets checklist signed, [ ] team membership granted, [ ] audit training complete. Prod perms will be blocked until complete.
noah (DevEx): i've approved and added you to `team/observability-dev` for dev paths. try `vault login` then `vault kv get kv/data/services/observability/metrics-ingest`.
emily (new-hire): can list and got a key back, thanks! last Q: any docs or playbooks to bookmark?
noah (DevEx): docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/secrets-onboarding, quick rotate playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rotation. also keep creds out of PRs and use the ephemeral flows.
emily (new-hire): perfect, huge help. thanks everyone :heart:
